extraction_notes: The exact ordering entry MJD45H11T4G is listed on p. 6 as DPAK, package 369C, Pb-Free, 2,500 units per tape and reel; electrical data are published for the MJD45H11 device family and its G/T4G/RLG variants.
The target is the PNP member. The datasheet states that the minus sign is omitted for PNP values unless otherwise noted.
Curve points are manual digitizations of visible plotted curves only; values are read from the plotted grid and are not interpolated between points.
The datasheet publishes Ccb/Cob but no Cibo/Ceb input-capacitance row; specs.cibo is null.
Maximum ratings on p. 1 additionally specify VEB = 5 V, IC continuous = 8 A, ICM peak = 16 A, PD = 20 W at TC = 25 degC, and TJ/Tstg = -55 to +150 degC.
The electrical table gives VCEO(sus) minimum 80 V at IC = 30 mA and IB = 0 on p. 2; the required vceo field records this electrical-characteristics value. The p. 1 maximum-rating VCEO is also 80 V.
No Early-voltage value is tabulated; output-characteristic curves needed to derive VAF are not published for this device family.
